hero.bodyFallback: We cultivate and produce premium palm sugar fruit and palm sugar, rooted in Indonesian agriculture and built for international markets.

about.bodyFallback: Bona Nauli Perkasa is an agriculture company dedicated to sustainable palm sugar production. From farm to export, we bring value and quality to every batch we produce.

team.bodyFallback: The people behind Bona Nauli Perkasa, working from farm to export to bring palm sugar to the world.

products.bodyFallback: Our core products are fresh palm sugar fruit (aren) and processed palm sugar, crafted with care for both local and global customers.

cta.bodyFallback: We are committed to bringing the value of Indonesian palm sugar to customers around the world. Partner with us.

summary.bodyFallback: Bona Nauli Perkasa is an Indonesian agriculture company built around one crop: the palm sugar tree.

visi.bodyFallback: To become a leading Indonesian palm sugar producer recognized internationally for quality and sustainability.

misi.bodyFallback:
Deliver consistently high-quality palm sugar products
Build long-term partnerships with local farmers
Expand access to international markets
